notes: Content Designer: every rune now lists everything it knows, so you choose what shows. Sensors offers every reading Charm shows (CPU, GPU, iGPU, memory, storage and network - each value, its unit and its name, plus each part's model name).…
Content Designer: text with no fixed length - a plan name, a track title - now stays inside the card and ends with an ellipsis, instead of running off the edge from a box sized for a dash.

Content Designer: Charm designs offer Charm's own fonts - the same list as Charm's Text settings - plus Anta, Sigil's own face. Mirage designs can use Anta too. A face that ships in one weight (Anta) only offers that weight.

Content Designer: a new Charm clock design starts as Charm's own clock card - the time with its AM/PM over the day and date, at Charm's sizes - and the canvas shows Charm designs in Charm's monospace font.
Charm's Text settings list gains Anta. Charm's sensor list now lives in one shared place that both Charm and the Content Designer read.
